text:
maria: heads up — invoice-preview showed a ~3% credit spike for a subset of tenants this morning :eyes:

jake: which subset? any common routing or plan tier?

maria: mostly EU tenants routed via edge-proxy-v2, all on pay-as-you-go. filtering by shard looks correlated with requests that hit the new header-strip change we rolled last week.

oliver: ahhh the strip-you-asked-for header change. that was intended to drop X-Internal when proxying to public endpoints. could be clobbering our route tag header `X-Route-Tag`

li: can we confirm by checking the raw ingest events? quick grep on `route_tag` in the kafka topic should show missing tags for those tenant ids.

maria: ran a lightweight query already. ~24k events missing route_tag in a 2h window starting 03:12 UTC. upstream edge logs still contain the header. something is dropping it between edge and metering-sidecar.

jake: timeline — we rolled proxy v2 on EU on Monday, metering-sidecar bump on Tuesday, canary for header normalize on Wednesday. any overlap?

oliver: yes, canary for header normalize targeted the same hosts as proxy-v2. hypothesis: header-strip filter middleware runs before header-preserve in the shared nginx/lua chain. order bug.

anya: product noticed invoice preview diffs and flagged to finance. they want a quick mitigation to avoid final invoices drifting.

li: short-term mitigation: replay missing route_tag by joining session ids with edge logs and re-enrich before aggregation. longer-term: fix header middleware ordering + add unit test in proxy that asserts `X-Route-Tag` is preserved for metering RPCs.

jake: replays are expensive but doable for the 2h window. need to estimate cost and whether we can auto-accept adjustments for affected tenants. finance walks in tomorrow ;(

maria: putting a canary rollback for the header-strip change on EU hosts now. will monitor invoice-preview.

sre-bot: deploy started: rollback header-strip v2 -> target eu-cluster-1. CI passed.

oliver: also propose we add a defensive fallback in metering-sidecar that copies `X-Forwarded-Route` -> `X-Route-Tag` if present, so future ordering bugs are survivable. small change, low risk.

li: agree. add a feature-flagged transform so we can toggle quickly. and add an integration test that runs the full edge->sidecar flow.

anya: can we also add a console alert? Dashboard should surface sudden drop in per-route token attribution (delta > 0.5% in 1h). finance wants an automated email if previews deviate beyond threshold.

maria: created a follow-up ticket: https://redwood.example/tickets/PLAT-7523 — includes replay steps, owner, and rollback notes.

jake: after rollback, invoice-preview reverted within 12 minutes for the sample tenants :chart_with_upwards_trend:. replay still needed for historical 2h window.

oliver: I'll open a PR for the middleware ordering fix + integration test. tagging @li for review.

li: will review today. also scheduling a postmortem with finance and product to agree replay/credit policy.

anya: thanks all. lesson: metering headers are part of our product contract — need stronger invariants and test harness. :thinking_face:
